observation.command:
cd /workspace; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/
# get sign-in page + csrf
curl -s -c /tmp/cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in -o /tmp/signin.html -w "signin: %{http_code}\n"
TOKEN=$(grep -oP 'name="authenticity_token" value="\K[^"]+' /tmp/signin.html | head -1)
echo "token: ${TOKEN:0:20}..."
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -c /tmp/cj.txt -o /tmp/after.html -w "login POST: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" \
  -d "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" -d "user[login]=admin@consul.dev" -d "user[password]=Aa12345678" -d "user[remember_me]=0" \
  http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in
grep -o "data-current-user-id=\"[^\"]*\"" /tmp/after.html | head -1
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/ -o /tmp/home.html -w "home: %{http_code}\n"
grep -o "data-current-user-id=\"[^\"]*\"" /tmp/home.html | head -1
